other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates the submission ID column using a simple sequence `np.arange()` instead of preserving the actual ID column from the test dataset. If the real test IDs are not sequentially numbered from 0, the submission will be misaligned or rejected.

summary: The agent sets up a reasonable pipeline with a 5-fold cross-validated ensemble of LightGBM and CatBoost. However, it fails to perform any feature engineering and uses a naive equal-weight average for ensembling. Furthermore, it leaks validation information during cross-validation by fitting preprocessing steps on the full training set prior to splitting, fails to report any evaluation metric scores, and hardcodes the submission IDs.
